class.name: GameplayAbility
class.brief_description: Base class for runtime gameplay ability instances managing execution logic, costs, cooldowns, and targeting.
class.description: [GameplayAbility] represents an active or ready instance of a gameplay ability bound to an owner [GAS_Entity]. It manages checking resource costs, applying cooldowns, validating tag conditions, resolving target entities, and applying gameplay effects. Custom ability behaviors can be defined by extending this class and overriding virtual hook methods like [method _activate_ability], [method _calculate_targets], and [method _check_availability].

method.name: _activate_ability
method.description: Virtual method called during [method try_activate] when custom activation logic is defined. Return [code]true[/code] if the ability successfully activated. Overriding this bypasses the default automatic effect application and auto-ending flow.

method.name: _calculate_targets
method.description: Virtual method called during default ability execution to resolve target entities. Returns an array of [GAS_Entity] instances to which the ability's gameplay effects will be applied.

method.name: _check_availability
method.description: Virtual method called during [method can_activate] to evaluate custom availability conditions. Must return [code]true[/code] to allow ability activation.

method.name: _end_ability
method.description: Virtual method called when the ability ends or is cancelled. Override this to perform cleanup or trigger termination logic. [param was_cancelled] is [code]true[/code] if execution was prematurely interrupted.

method.name: apply_effects_to_target
method.description: Applies all configured [EffectData] resources from this ability to the specified target [param entity]. If [param entity] is [code]null[/code], effects are applied to the owner entity instead.

method.name: can_activate
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the ability is currently in an idle state, meets resource costs, passes tag requirements, is not on cooldown, and satisfies [method _check_availability].

method.name: commit_ability
method.description: Commits the ability by validating availability, applying resource costs, and starting cooldown timers. Returns [code]true[/code] if the commit succeeded.

method.name: get_ability_data
method.description: Returns the [AbilityData] resource configuration associated with this runtime ability instance.

method.name: get_entity_owner
method.description: Returns the owner [GAS_Entity] that owns and executes this ability.

method.name: is_on_cooldown
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this ability's applied cooldown effect is currently active and unexpired.

method.name: set_ability_data
method.description: Sets the [AbilityData] resource configuration for this ability instance.

method.name: try_activate
method.description: Attempts to activate the ability. Checks [method can_activate] before executing custom logic in [method _activate_ability] or proceeding with default commit, targeting, and effect application routines. Returns [code]true[/code] if activation succeeded.

method.name: try_end
method.description: Attempts to end execution of this ability. If currently active, invokes [method _end_ability] and resets the state to idle.
